## Purpose and Runtime

PaperTodo is a Windows x64 desktop sticky-note application: independent borderless WPF windows represent todo lists or Markdown-like notes, with no primary application window. It targets .NET 10/WPF and runs persistently through the system tray. Application startup is defined by `App.xaml` and `App.xaml.cs`; project packaging/runtime dependencies are defined in `PaperTodo.csproj`.

## Application Control Plane

`AppController.cs` is the application-level coordinator for note lifecycle, tray-driven actions, persistence, and global behavior. Its partials separate high-level concerns: settings in `AppController.Settings.cs`, tray/menu integration in `AppController.Tray.cs`, and keyboard command handling in `AppController.Shortcuts.cs`. `StartupCommand.cs` parses command-line intents such as show/hide/toggle/create/exit, while `SingleInstanceHelper.cs` forwards subsequent launches to the already-running process.

## Persistent State and Asset Storage

The primary model/state boundary is `Models.cs` plus `StateStore.cs`: note content, window geometry, settings, and UI state are saved to `data.json`, with backup/recovery behavior. Note images are deliberately outside JSON: `NoteImageStore.cs` resolves image references used in Markdown content and persists binaries through `LmdbImageDatabase.cs`. The latter wraps the packaged native LMDB library via `LmdbNative.cs`; native source/build/distribution assets live under `native/lmdb/`.

## Note and Todo Window Surface

`PaperWindow.cs` is the core independent-paper window, divided into lifecycle/native-window concerns and type-specific presentation. `PaperWindow.Note.cs` hosts text/Markdown editing behavior, while `PaperWindow.Todo.cs` implements item-oriented todo interactions. `PaperWindow.Lifecycle.cs` governs showing, hiding, restoring, and disposal; `PaperWindow.Native.cs` handles Windows-level window behavior. `TodoTextBox.cs` and `MarkdownTextBox.cs` are the specialized editing controls behind each paper mode.

## Markdown and Embedded Images

Markdown is intentionally a lightweight editor/rendering layer rather than a full document system. `MarkdownTextBox.cs` provides editor-facing formatting/highlighting behavior; `MarkdownFencedCodeScanner.cs` identifies fenced code regions, and `MarkdownImageReferences.cs` parses internal image references. This layer connects note text to `NoteImageStore.cs`, keeping images transactionally stored in LMDB while preserving references in note content.

## Capsule Mode and Edge Docking

Collapsed papers become capsules governed by a distinct state/presentation pipeline. `EdgeCapsuleModel.cs` represents capsule state, `EdgeCapsuleReducer.cs` applies state transitions, and `EdgeCapsuleTransitionPolicy.cs` determines permitted behavior. `EdgeCapsuleQueueCoordinator.cs` manages per-screen edge queues; `EdgeCapsuleTargetPlanner.cs` and `EdgeCapsuleLayoutService.cs` compute docking targets and layout. Rendering and animation are separated through `EdgeCapsuleHost.cs`, `EdgeCapsulePresenter.cs`, and `EdgeCapsuleFrameScheduler.cs`.

## Windows and System Integration

`AppController.Tray.cs` provides the sole global user entry point through the notification-area icon. `GlobalHotkeys.cs` supports application shortcuts, and `FullscreenForegroundWindowDetector.cs` enables the fullscreen visibility/always-on-top policy. Window placement and monitor-aware geometry use `ScreenGeometry.cs`, `WindowWorkAreaHelper.cs`, and `WindowNative.cs`. Theme, system appearance, and localized strings are represented by `Theme.cs`, `SystemSettingsHelper.cs`, and `Resources/Strings*.resx`.

## External Execution and Distribution

Notes can be handed to Windows-associated external editors and can act as PowerShell-backed script capsules; this behavior is integrated through the application/window command path rather than a server or web boundary. Release automation is in `.github/workflows/release.yml`, producing signed Windows single-file executables. Native image persistence is built with CMake from `native/lmdb/CMakeLists.txt`; key managed dependencies are WPF, AvalonEdit, and Hardcodet.NotifyIcon.Wpf.
